title: A tractable streaming moment with square-root cancellation cost in symmetric Lévy decompositions

comparators.scope: Thirty-seven fixed explicit specification targets including the complete thm11_full, operational streaming, recovery, analytic kernels and approximation bounds. Does not assert the three external consequences.
Same 37-target suite with complete Theorem 1.1 weakened by an extra premise. Rejection detail: added False premise on Verification.Certificate.thm11_full.

main_results.scope: Bit-space streaming membership, ENNReal cancellation bounds, all-cutoff upper bound, square-root asymptotics, and failure of the original bivariate polynomial implication.
Finite positive circle measure and exact mass for the original Lévy cone; dual and normalized-generator conclusions allow arbitrary Lévy measures.
Rudin–Shapiro norm/energy identity, exact transitions, and parity-dependent pairing with the endpoint correction.
Cone lower bound, strict all-cutoff consequence, and exact real-even Fourier–Hahn split with the square-root envelope.
Halting one-pass bit-space program for arbitrary integer updates with failure probability at most delta; bounded-weight extension assumes the stated single-weight evaluator.
Sparse/dense recovery, checksum probability, and halting decoder workspace. Polynomial Gaussian-elimination runtime is outside the formalized scope.
Analytic complete-Bernstein/Pick kernel properties over the stated parameter range.
Finite-difference identities, approximation, envelopes, and cost constants. Membership requiring the general analytic-to-positive-measure representation theorem remains outside the proved scope.
